signal: Feature drift (PSI vs training benign traffic)
threshold_or_trigger: Any feature PSI > 0.25 for 2 consecutive days, or > 0.1 for 7 days
owner_and_response: ML owner (Ojas) re-checks the feature against the capture pipeline, then decides retrain or roll back
feedback_use: Drifting features are the first candidates for the next refit

threshold_or_trigger: >2,889 alerts/day (3x the busiest of 7 unseen days), or any alert from a source and port that normally produce none
owner_and_response: SOC duty analyst triages; a spike is either a real scan campaign or a broken sensor, and both need an answer the same day

threshold_or_trigger: Median alert score drops below 0.90, or the share of alerts scoring 0.50-0.70 doubles
owner_and_response: ML owner reviews calibration; borderline alerts mean the boundary has moved
feedback_use: Triggers threshold re-selection on fresh labelled data

threshold_or_trigger: Confirmed-true rate on sampled alerts falls below 90% over a rolling 2 weeks
owner_and_response: SOC lead and ML owner review the false alarms together
feedback_use: Confirmed labels go straight into the retraining pool

signal: Missed scans found after the fact
threshold_or_trigger: Any scan confirmed by another control that ScanShield did not flag
owner_and_response: Treated as an incident review: the flow is replayed against the model and added to the regression set
feedback_use: Becomes a permanent test case the next model must pass

threshold_or_trigger: Suppression share above 25% of alerts, or any entry past its expiry date
owner_and_response: Security team re-approves or removes the entry
feedback_use: Keeps the allowlist from quietly becoming a blind spot

threshold_or_trigger: Scheduled review every 90 days regardless of other signals
owner_and_response: Both owners re-run the full pipeline on recent traffic
feedback_use: Retrain on the accumulated confirmed labels
